title: Random Math
text:
Random Math summer camp and classes coach students in Grades 3-12 to succeed in AMC8/10/12, AIME, USAJMO and other elementary, middle and high school competitions.

108 out of 125 students qualified for AIME in November, 2021 with a Result Density of 86%.

Note: Random Math only includes results of its current student who paid for the program. Neither we solicit high performers to join "free classes" or "our teams" to inflate results nor do we rely on our alumni for our results. Our current students is what matters!!!

Schedule an assessment at Random Math to see if you qualify to become a part of the Random Math family - https://www.randommath.com/assessment

Random Math will be offering 4 different camps at 7 different levels this year during the summer:

- June 12 - June 16, 2022 : Number Theory

- June 19 - June 30, 2022 : Algebra

- July 10 - July 28, 2022 : Geometry

- July 31 - Aug 11, 2022 : Counting and Probability


More information is available at https://www.randommath.com/summer-camps
